costs.label: V1 repeated tile
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Keep as control; source is the delivered V1 tile.

costs.label: Painted style proof
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Large diagonal crack motifs still repeat. A painted label alone does not remove wallpaper.

costs.label: Low-frequency multiply
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Changes broad values with 64 KiB; does not fix seams. Cheaper: vertex tint patches.

costs.label: Seeded decals
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: 64 marks add clutter. Candidate stack uses 32 smaller, fainter marks. Cheaper: reuse fewer regions.

costs.label: Baked course
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: 4 MiB target exceeds remaining production headroom; 1024 bake softens 1080p edges. Cheaper: live ribbon with shared atlas.

costs.label: Ink edges and shoulders
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Clear boundaries lift the course, but uniform bands feel too geometric. Cheaper: two vertex-colour edge strips.

costs.label: Warm grade and dust
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: One ground shader and 28 alpha quads; no full-screen blur. Cheaper: warm vertex tint, no particles.

costs.label: Tall props and shadows
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Depth reads, but repeated V1 rocks clash with rough cars. Cheaper: sparse existing props and shared shadow mask.

costs.label: Persistent wear buffer
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Dark repeated stamps distract and add a full-screen layer plus 1 MiB. Cheaper: capped live skid sprites.

costs.label: Poster and grain
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Quantisation/grain amplifies coarse pattern and shimmer. Cheaper: paint grain into approved tiles.

costs.label: Ground value separation
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Darker desaturated floor separates car accents. Cheaper: a tuned ground tint.

costs.label: All layers combined
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Too much grain, repeated props and black wear. Combined cost is measured, not a sum of single-feature deltas.

costs.label: Live edges and decals
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Painted ground + seeded decals + edges; near 16.7 ms cadence. Same content as the bake, with no extra target. Source motifs and decal density still need art review.

costs.label: Restrained stack
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Macro + 32 decals + filled edges + 28 dust sprites + value separation still misses the nominal 16.7 ms target. Retained as the optimisation control.

costs.label: Narrow-band stack
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Narrow bands, 16 decals and 8 dust sprites reduce submitted coverage, but rebuilding more geometry raises CPU cost. Paired against restrained on revision 2.

costs.label: Cached geometry (held)
costs.observation_and_cheaper_swap: Identical pixels and lower CPU cost with a 0.192 MiB vertex cache, but p50 remains above nominal 16.7 ms. Paired against dynamic geometry on revision 3; no combined default accepted.

method: Median of per-run statistics, except max_ms is worst observed across repeats; 240 warmup + 900 samples/run; glFinish each frame. Completion is CPU+GPU wall time, not a GPU timer. PSS one sample per run. Fill is submitted geometry proxy, not fragments. Negative small deltas can be noise.

production_budget.status: static edges/decals is an owner option; graded cached design held on frame cost; all proposals require chosen kit repack and integrated measurement
